rows.en: (Phew~ Training's finally over...)

Michel, wanna grab something to eat
on the way home?
Yeah, I don't mind.

Where should we go?
And no places where the only thing
they've got going is cute girls.
Like I'd ever take you to a place like that...
We'll see about that...
Just what do you take me for...
You two sure get along.
You're...
Cathy-san!
Good evening, you two.
Did you have some business with S.M.S.?
Yes, just a dull little errand.
rows.notes: 'yaboyou' = a trivial errand she does not want to explain.

rows.en: That must be a pain...
But I'm done with it now.

In that case, Cathy-san,
would you care to join us?
Won't you come out to eat with us after this?

I'm sorry.
I still have work to do after this.

O-Oh, I see.
That's a shame.
Ask me again some other time.
Bye, Cathy-san~

Guess your Pretty-Boy Smile doesn't
work every time, huh, Michel.
rows.notes: 'ikemen sumairu' made into a mock name, since Michel's reply objects to the player naming it.

rows.en: Don't go giving it weird names.
Let's shake it off and go eat!
Yeah, I guess...
rows.notes: x14 generic agreement (Michel, Alto, Yamashiro, Kagura, player).

rows.en: (Maybe Cathy-san's a really serious person~)

Michel-kun, want to grab something to eat
on the way home?
Sure, I don't mind.

Hey, where should we go?
And no places where the only thing
they've got going is cute girls.
rows.notes: Female version of c01564; same complaint in the Japanese.

rows.en: Like I'd ever take you to a place like that...
I'd like to believe that, but...
Just what do you take me for?

So your Pretty-Boy Smile doesn't
always work, huh, Michel-kun.
(Phew, training was rough again today.)
Make sure you get some proper rest.
Good work today, Captain Ozma!

Good work, Ozma.
You too, \p-kun.
rows.notes: Shared male/female in the Japanese (Cathy says \p-kun to both).

rows.en: What's up, Cathy?

...I was wondering if you'd like
to get dinner after this.
rows.notes: Cathy is asking Ozma alone; he answers by inviting the player.

rows.en:
Hmm...
What do you say, \p?
...Huh?
What?
...What's wrong?
You've really got it rough, Cathy-san.
This is nothing new...

What's with you two whispering
behind my back?
It's nothing, sir!

I've got plans after this,
so you two go on ahead!
S-See you, \p-kun.
(Cathy-san sure has her work cut out for her...)

I've got plans after this,
so you two go on ahead!
S-See you, \p-san.

(That's Deep Akihabara for you...
The selection's on a whole other level.
I don't even know where to look first.)
Ah!

Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...
Whaddya think you're doin', pal?
rows.notes: Thug speaks Kansai dialect: rendered as rough street English. 'oniichan' to a young stranger = 'pal'.

rows.en:
I-I'm sorry!
Are you hurt?

I ain't hurt, but my precious...
my precious wine...
Oh, I'm really sorry...
Whatcha gonna do about it...

If sorry cut it, we wouldn't need cops...
You get that much, don'tcha, pal?
Y-Yes... well... I guess...
...Sorry, but how 'bout you pay me back for it?

P-Pay you back...?
Just out of curiosity, how much would that be...?

rows.notes: x4: said again in the scene after Luis calls his bluff (same line reused).

rows.en: T-Two hundred thousand!!
200,000 is a bit much for me...

Can't pay, huh?
How much ya got on ya? Lemme see your wallet!
M-My wallet's, um...

Hold it, old man.
Nobody pulls the fake-collision scam
these days, y'know?
rows.notes: 'atariya' = someone who bumps into people on purpose and demands compensation. Male version.

rows.en: Wh-Who're you!?

Luis Fernando...
Just a nice guy who happened to be passing by...
Luis-san!!
Long time no see, Fresh Boy...

Hey, hey, butt out!
This ain't got nothin' to do with you, Frizz-head!
rows.notes: 'chijire-ge' (frizzy/curly hair), which Luis corrects to dreadlocks.

rows.en:
Frizz-head? Non, non.
It's called dreadlocks, y'know?

Like I care!
I'm talkin' to this kid here!
N-No way! I can't pay that kind of money!!
Fresh Boy, don't let him fool you...
Nobody asked you, so shut yer trap!!

Oh, no. I'm this young man's guardian.
I can't just look the other way...
rows.notes: Male version; the thug and player react to the claim next.

uncertain: c01602: x73 generic 'e?' rendered 'What?' (c00794 'e?' is already 'Huh?').
c01624: the thug's '200,000' line is reused after Luis calls his bluff; '200,000 yen.' works as a stubborn repeat.
c01615/c01620/c01636: thug's 'oniichan/niichan' to the player rendered 'pal'/'kid' (stranger, not kinship).
